label: Meaning & Purpose
raw_text: Make connections between words and phrases and use reference materials to determine or clarify word meanings in a variety of settings and for a variety of purposes.
child_texts: Use context within and beyond a sentence to determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases. (I)
Identify the relationship between words and their synonyms and antonyms. (I)
Distinguish shades of meaning among verbs that describe the same general action (e.g., walk, march, strut, prance). (I)
With teacher support, use a picture dictionary or digital resource to clarify the meaning of unknown words and phrases. (I)
Use knowledge of word relationships and learned vocabulary words and phrases when making word choices in speaking and writing. (C)
competency_statement: Students make connections between words and phrases and use reference materials to determine or clarify word meanings in different situations and for various purposes.
observable_behaviors: Use context clues within and beyond sentences to figure out the meaning of unknown or multiple-meaning words and phrases.

Notice and explain subtle differences in meaning among verbs that describe similar actions.
